name: morph-dialog
title: Morph Dialog
description: A card that becomes its own dialog. The trigger's container, image and title travel to their places in the dialog and back, through the View Transitions API where available and a FLIP animation elsewhere. Underneath it is a native modal <dialog>: focus is trapped and returned, the page is inert and its scroll locked, Escape closes. Reduced motion crossfades instead.
